IRS990.MissionDesc: To improve and expand sustainable Christ-centered education globally.
IRS990.Desc: Edify comes alongside entrepreneurs who offer quality Christ-centered education to children in their underserved communities. We partner with them using three key resources to help improve and expand their schools: 1.Training to equip school leaders and teachers to develop sustainable Christ-centered schools. 2.Loan Capital to improve and expand school facilities. 3.Education Technology to enhance learning outcomes and employability. Persons served in fiscal year 2024 - 8,437,613 comprised of 8,388,449 children, 49,164 leaders and teachers Schools served in fiscal year 2024 - 34,086 in 14 developing world countries

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Edify offers donor vision trips for individuals, families, and couples. These immersive experiences provide a unique opportunity to witness the impact of their work in Africa and Latin America, connect with local communities, and deepen one's understanding of Edify's mission.By visiting schools, meeting educators and students, and engaging with local staff, participants gain an in-depth, firsthand perspective on the challenges and triumphs of Christ-centered education in under-resourced communities. These trips are also designed to be a spiritually enriching experience, encouraging participants to reflect on their faith and discern how they can contribute to "giving God more miracle-working space," as described by Edify.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 11b Review of form 990 by governing body
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Form 990 is prepared by an independent CPA firm and then provided to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors to review prior to filing. After the return is thoroughly reviewed by the CEO and CFO, it is given back to the CPA for electronic filing with the IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 12c Conflict of interest policy
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Edify requires officers, directors, senior management team, and key employees to disclose in writing information regarding their interests and those of their family members that could give rise to conflicts of interest or an appearance of impropriety. Written disclosures are updated at least annually. Actual or potential conflicts of interest will be reviewed by the CEO, Chairman, or Vice Chairman of the Board, and then presented to the Governance, Nominating and Compensation Committee. Persons with a disclosed actual or potential conflict will be prohibited from participating in deliberations and decisions by the Governing Board or Governance, Nominating and Compensation Committee. If a conflict is proved to exist, the person with the conflict will be asked to discontinue such action/relationship or otherwise remove such conflict.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 15a Process to establish compensation of top management official
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The independent board approves and documents in the board meeting minutes the salary for the CEO after reviewing compensation committee recommendations based upon industry standards and published non-profit surveys for comparable positions.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 15b Process to establish compensation of other employees
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Compensation for all other officers is set by the CEO based on industry standards and comparable salaries. Substantiation of this process is documented in personnel files.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 19 Required documents available to the public
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The governing documents, conflict of interest policy, and financial statements are made available upon request.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule F, Part I, Line 3 Foreign expenditure accounting method
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Foreign partners that receive funding from Edify for training activities and loans to schools are required to submit an accounting of expenses on a monthly or quarterly basis. For specific training events the budget is approved in advance with a final reconciliation of actual to budgeted expenses upon completion. All travel expenses of Edify staff and agents overseas are accounted for with expense reports and supporting documentation. The accrual method of accounting is used for all transactions.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: In order to operate under the laws in Ghana, Uganda, and Rwanda, Edify established local foreign non-governmental organizations (NGOs). The Ghana NGO has the same board as the filing organization. All of the Uganda NGO's board is comprised of either Edify US board members or Edify US corporate officers. A majority of the Rwanda NGO's board is made up of a combination of Edify US board members and Edify US corporate officers. For all three entities, the NGOs' operations represent Edify's operations in Ghana, Uganda and Rwanda under Edify's Board supervision. Per our interpretation of the Form 990 instructions and in order to file a complete and accurate return, the NGOs' operations are included in the financial activity reported on this Form 990 and the NGOs are reported in Schedule R, Part II as related tax-exempt organizations.
